## Checklist

- [ ] One change per pull request; unrelated fixes go in their own
- [ ] `just check` passes (format, analyze, tests on the VM and JavaScript)
- [ ] Tests added or updated — a fixed bug gets a regression test
- [ ] Golden snapshots updated and reviewed, if highlighting changed
- [ ] No breaking change, or it is called out below
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under `## Unreleased` in each package changed
- [ ] Docs updated if behaviour or API changed
